title: Choose the visual world · re-roll 1
question: Steered toward videogames and sci-fi. The roll assigned Persona 3 Reload's Dark Hour. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Dark Hour (Persona 3 Reload)
options.lineage: Persona 3 Reload's menu system: midnight, the moon, water, slanted liquid UI
options.thesis: The portfolio runs on the hidden hour after midnight: a dithered moonlit sea behind a slanted pause menu where every section is a menu command.
options.viewport: Giant 00:00 behind, the name in tilted heavy italic on the left, a dithered portrait cut-in at the same tilt, the nav as a slanted pause menu on the right with a cyan blade on the active item, CV as 'Save Data'.
options.risk: Close enough to the game to read as fan art; it must be translated (no Atlus assets, own type), and the slanted type has to stay readable for recruiters who don't play games.

raised.raise: Light/dark is home/away: Day and Dark Hour swap the whole colourway while the layout and emblem stay identical.
Every section is a named hour on the clock, labelled in text, so colour never carries meaning alone.
Three values only: ink, midnight blue, and the one cyan; no stray tints.
Cyan is one continuous run: the active blade, the links, the cursor, never scattered decoration.
The portrait has states: it changes pose per section, like the party portrait in the game menu.
Motion is damped and physical; only menu cuts snap.

options.label: Calling Card (Persona 5)
options.lineage: Persona 5's Phantom Thieves UI: ransom-note type, halftone red, jagged panels
options.thesis: Every section is a calling card: ransom-note letters, red halftone dither and hard jagged cuts, and the contact form is the card you send.
options.viewport: Red halftone field, the name as cut-out ransom letters on a jagged black slab, a tilted halftone portrait card, nav in stroked heavy caps, CV as 'Take my CV'.
options.risk: The most copied game UI on the web and the flat red-black-white ink rut; loud enough to tire a recruiter. Also the direction most runs would pick.

options.label: Galaxy Map (Mass Effect)
options.lineage: Mass Effect's Normandy galaxy map, codex and dialogue wheel
options.thesis: The portfolio as a star chart: projects are star systems, the bio is a codex entry, contact is the dialogue wheel.
options.viewport: Thin spaced caps name over a dithered nebula, MAGI as the lit system on orbital rings, a codex excerpt, CV as 'Download Dossier'.
options.risk: Orange holo on near-black is the neon-on-black rut, and a full 3D map is heavy; you named it, so it's here alongside the roll.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Sections as light cues from night to day.
options.viewport: A black wall with a cobalt horizon rising behind the name.
options.case: Beautiful but theatre, not games; the steer goes elsewhere.
options.kept: Named phases so colour is never the only signal.

options.label: Hand-Bent Neon
options.thesis: The name as one continuous glass tube.
options.viewport: A dark room, the name igniting in cobalt neon.
options.case: The neon-on-black rut with no tie to Camilo.
options.kept: The accent as one continuous circuit.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Page
options.thesis: A scholarly edition with a keyed centre rail.
options.viewport: Two narrow columns around a vermilion key rail.
options.case: A reading world; far from games and the brief's dithering.

options.label: Football Kit Crest
options.thesis: Camilo's shirt: crest over the heart, number on the back.
options.viewport: A shirt front with crest and sponsor lockup.
options.case: Sports, not games; misses the steer.
options.kept: Home/away colourway swap with the emblem untouched.

options.label: Hand-Drawn Zine
options.thesis: A friend explaining MAGI on a napkin.
options.viewport: Doodled arrows from a mascot to the name.
options.case: Cute and cream-paper; opposite of the steer.
options.kept: A character whose expression marks state.

options.label: Night-Flight Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six gauges, each one truth about Camilo.
options.viewport: Two rows of three gauges reading stack and status.
options.case: An instrument costume; metrics he doesn't have.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The minimal dev portfolio (chanhdai.com lineage) executed impeccably: ASCII header, hairline column, one accent.
canonCard.viewport: A centred hairline column: ASCII banner, round dithered avatar, name, one-line role, CV button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from hundreds of dev portfolios by design.
